title: Untitled
altText: Vibrant horizontal street art mural by Italian artist Mr Blob at The Bushwick Collective in Brooklyn, New York, featuring an orange surreal dragon character stretching across a dark brick factory wall.
description: Painted at The Bushwick Collective in Brooklyn, this horizontal piece stretches a surreal orange creature across the dark brick of a factory wall, its body unraveling into a long, net-like stream of cyan feathers and threads that weaves between the windows. Smaller characters surface along the flow, turning the constraints of the architecture into the rhythm of the composition.
